create.name: Sara Auster
create.bio:
Sara Auster is a sound bath facilitator, meditation teacher and author who has done much to bring the sound bath from a niche practice into the mainstream. Her sessions use crystal and metal bowls, gongs, tuning forks and voice, and they rest on what she calls Full-Body Listening: attending to sound with every sense rather than only with the ears, as a way into stillness, self-awareness and a closer connection with the world around you. She came to this work through her own long path of recovery after an accident, which led her through many teachings before she settled on sound and listening.

She leads regular evening sound baths in New York City, often at Tibet House US alongside the sound practitioner Alex Falk, and has taken large group listening sessions into museums, concert halls and cultural institutions such as MoMA and the Rubin Museum, as well as working with companies and brands. Her Auster Sound Method is taught in a three-phase practitioner training, online and in person, for people who want to guide sound baths themselves, and her PAUSE app offers recorded listening sessions for the start and end of the day. She is the author of Sound Bath, a guide to the practice, and has led programmes at Kripalu.

courses.title: Auster Sound Method Practitioner Training
courses.description: Sara's certification course for anyone who wants to guide one-to-one and group sound baths, taught online and in person in three phases. It moves from full-body listening through instruments, technique and finding your own voice as a practitioner; 2027 dates are still to be announced.

courses.title: ASM Sound Bath w/ Sara Auster & Alex Falk (12 November 2026)
courses.description: An evening group sound bath at Tibet House US in Manhattan with bowls, gongs and other resonant instruments, led by Sara and Alex Falk. No experience is needed; mats and chairs are provided.

courses.title: ASM Sound Bath w/ Sara Auster & Alex Falk (15 December 2026)
courses.description: December's evening group sound bath at Tibet House US in New York, an hour and a half of guided listening with Sara and Alex Falk. Booking ahead is advised.

courses.title: PAUSE App
courses.description: Sara's subscription app of recorded sound baths and guided listening sessions for the morning, short breaks in the day and winding down at night. A free trial is offered.
